label: Ask a person
description: Pauses the workflow and asks a person a question (or shows a form). Their answer is saved in a data field and the workflow continues.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go once the person has answered: connect the next step, or Finish.

prompt.title: Question for the person
prompt.description: Jinja template, e.g. Which plan should we use for {{ state.customer }}?

response_schema.title: Answer form (JSON Schema)
response_schema.description: Optional; the answer is validated against it and the question is asked again if invalid.

output.title: Save the answer in
output.description: The data field that receives the person's answer.

approvers.title: Who may answer
approvers.description: Leave empty to let anyone who answers the Inbox decide (and, once published, whoever calls the workflow). Naming roles, groups or people sends the decision to them only.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Members with one of these roles.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups your identity provider keeps over SCIM, by name.

caller.title: Whoever calls the published workflow may answer too
caller.description: Its deployment key, an MCP or A2A client, a share link or an event handler.

not_initiator.title: Not the person who started the run
